shared_elements: low-relief carving on a stone surface
justification: A shows a repeating vegetal motif — long-stemmed flowers with radiating petals and spiral/volute buds arranged in a vertical trailing pattern over a rectangular panel — while B shows a single massive human or hominid face, with brow ridge, deep-set eyes and nose, carved on a block. There is no shared subject matter, no comparable relationships between elements, and the modes of depiction (flat repeating ornament vs. sculptural three-dimensional physiognomy) share nothing beyond both being carved stone.
